notes: APK 48: Bluesky for language only. Say !bluesky connect and sign in with a Bluesky app password (never your main password; it is used once and never stored). !bluesky read reads up to 200 posts from Following and your saved For You feed into Lantern's language minds; no post text, names, handles or emails are kept, nothing becomes a fact, and Lantern never posts. !bluesky status, !bluesky disconnect.
